harness.label: Harness
harness.hint: Choose the agent harness that runs your tasks.

engine.label: Execution engine
engine.hint: Default uses ACP. If ACP is unavailable, the run fails with a setup error. Choose CLI explicitly to use it.

repoUrl.label: GitHub repository
repoUrl.hint: Select a repository or a named Cursor cloud environment.

cursor.description: Experimental. Cursor hosts this agent’s execution environment. A Paperclip computer is not required. Cursor manages command permissions; effective model identity is unavailable. Agent environment settings support only CURSOR_API_KEY. Configure hosted secrets in your Cursor Cloud environment.

connection.label: Dot connection
connection.hint: A verified event round trip is required before assigning work.

attachments.label: Read task attachments
attachments.hint: Let Dot read files attached to its current assigned task. File contents are sent to OpenAI. Does not require workspace command access; off by default.

workspace.label: Workspace files and commands
workspace.hint: Let Dot read and write its assigned workspace and publish files. Requires a local Runner. Commands are available only on Linux with bubblewrap; they cannot read your home directory or use injected credentials.

dot.unmeteredHint: Dot does not report token usage or cost. Paperclip cannot enforce a provider spend ceiling; known company and agent budget limits still apply.

connection.label: Muse connection
connection.hint: Pairing, receiver contact, background reply, and agent setup are verified separately.

muse.unmeteredHint: Muse does not report usage or cost. Paperclip cannot enforce a Muse spend ceiling; known company and agent budget limits still apply.

acpAgent.label: ACP agent
acpAgent.hint: Choose a qualified harness and enter its exact model ID.

cursorMode.label: Cursor mode
cursorMode.hint: Select Cursor's session mode. Permissions and company approval rules still apply.
cursorMode.unsupported: Unsupported saved mode — select Agent, Plan, or Ask

piThinking.label: Pi thinking level
piThinking.hint: The runner verifies this exact level before each session can prompt. Changing it starts a new session.

profile.label: Managed Agent profile
profile.hint: Company-scoped qualified profile ID or key. Remote resource identity is loaded from the stored profile, not this agent config.

ceiling.label: Session spend ceiling (USD)
ceiling.hint: Optional per-agent hard ceiling. Leave 1.00 to use a conservative default.

retention.label: Acknowledge managed retention
retention.hint: Claude Managed is a stateful beta service and is not eligible for ZDR or HIPAA modes.

profile.label: AgentCore profile
profile.hint: Company-scoped qualified profile ID or key. Harness, Memory, IAM, and context-store identity come from the stored profile.

ceiling.label: Estimated session ceiling (USD)
ceiling.hint: Paperclip estimate; AWS does not provide a per-session currency hard stop.

maxIterations.label: Maximum iterations
maxIterations.hint: Qualified range is 1–8. Invalid values fail closed to 8.

retention.label: Acknowledge 90-day Memory retention
retention.hint: The qualified AgentCore profile retains short-term Memory events for exactly 90 days.

permissionMode.label: Permission mode
permissionMode.hint: {{description}} The selected mode does not widen Paperclip's workspace, network, credential, or planning boundaries.
permissionMode.unsupported: Unsupported saved mode — select a qualified mode
permissionMode.codexUnsupported: This saved Codex mode cannot start or recover a Paperclip Runner run. Select Automatic (isolated) to remediate it.

lifecycle.label: Runner lifecycle
lifecycle.hint: Automatic keeps Codex and OpenCode warm on this computer for 5 minutes after a run, so a follow-up starts faster, and runs other harnesses turn by turn. Turn by turn suspends after each run. Warm keeps the same provider process available between governed runs.

warmIdle.label: Warm idle timeout (ms)
warmIdle.hint: After this much inactivity, runnerd checkpoints and suspends the provider session. The maximum is 24 hours.

serverCommand.label: ACP server command
serverCommand.hint: Optional override for the Codex ACP server command. Defaults to the package-local codex-acp binary.

sessionMode.label: ACP session mode
sessionMode.hint: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.

nonInteractive.label: ACP non-interactive permissions
nonInteractive.hint: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.

stateDir.label: ACP state directory
stateDir.hint: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Paperclip-managed organization/agent scoped storage.

warmIdle.label: ACP warm process idle ms
warmIdle.hint: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.

instructionsFile.label: Agent instructions file
instructionsFile.hint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime. Note: Codex may still auto-apply repo-scoped AGENTS.md files from the workspace.

fastMode.label: Fast mode
fastMode.manual: Fast mode will be passed through for this manual model. If Codex rejects it, turn the toggle off.
fastMode.supported: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
fastMode.unsupported: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}} or manual model IDs. Paperclip will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.
